27	  descent_set (rev_perm s) = [set rev_ord i | i in ~: descent_set s].

29	apply/setP => j; rewrite !inE.
30	apply/idP/imsetP.

62	- case=> y; rewrite inE => HyND ->.

1	(* Layer 2: descent set, descent number, ascent number. *)
2	From mathcomp Require Import all_ssreflect fingroup perm.
3	From mathcomp_eulerian Require Import ordinal_reindex perm_compress.
4	
5	Set Implicit Arguments.
6	Unset Strict Implicit.
7	Unset Printing Implicit Defensive.
8	
9	(* ========================================================================= *)
10	(* Descent predicate and descent set                                         *)
11	(* ========================================================================= *)
12	
13	Section Descent.
14	Variable n : nat.
15	Implicit Types (s : {perm 'I_n.+1}) (i : 'I_n).
16	
17	(* A position i : 'I_n is a descent of s : {perm 'I_n.+1} if               *)
18	(*   s(i) > s(i+1)                                                         *)
19	(* (positions of s are in 'I_n.+1 = {0,...,n}; descents are between         *)
20	(* consecutive positions so i ranges over 'I_n).                           *)
21	
22	Definition is_descent s i : bool :=
23	  s (widen_ord (leqnSn n) i) > s (lift ord0 i).
24	
25	Definition descent_set s : {set 'I_n} := [set i | is_descent s i].
26	
27	Definition des s : nat := #|descent_set s|.
28	
29	Definition asc s : nat := n - des s.
30	
31	Lemma is_descentE s i :
32	  is_descent s i = (s (widen_ord (leqnSn n) i) > s (lift ord0 i)).
33	Proof. by []. Qed.
34	
35	Lemma mem_descent_set s i : (i \in descent_set s) = is_descent s i.
36	Proof. by rewrite inE. Qed.
37	
38	Lemma des_le s : des s <= n.
39	Proof. by rewrite /des (leq_trans (max_card _)) // card_ord. Qed.
40	
41	Lemma des_add_asc s : des s + asc s = n.
42	Proof. by rewrite /asc subnKC // des_le. Qed.
43	
44	Lemma des_id : des (1 : {perm 'I_n.+1}) = 0.
45	Proof.
46	apply/eqP; rewrite cards_eq0; apply/eqP/setP => i; rewrite !inE.
47	by rewrite /is_descent !perm1 ltnNge /= leqW.
48	Qed.
49	
50	End Descent.
51	
52	(* ========================================================================= *)
53	(* Interaction with Layer 1: descents and drop_perm                          *)
54	(* ========================================================================= *)
55	
56	Section DescentDrop.
57	Variable n : nat.
58	
59	(* Descents at interior positions are preserved by drop_perm.                *)
60	(* More precisely: for σ : {perm 'I_n.+2} and i : 'I_n, the descent of       *)
61	(* drop_perm σ at i corresponds to the descent of σ at widen_ord i.           *)
62	
63	Lemma is_descent_drop (s : {perm 'I_n.+2}) (i : 'I_n) :
64	  is_descent (drop_perm s) i = is_descent s (widen_ord (leqnSn _) i).
65	Proof.
66	rewrite /is_descent -(ltn_lift (s ord_max)) !lift_drop_permE.
67	congr (s _ < s _); apply: val_inj; exact: lift_max.
68	Qed.
69	
70	End DescentDrop.
71	
72	(* ========================================================================= *)
73	(* Reversal-complement symmetry                                              *)
74	(* ========================================================================= *)
75	
76	Section DescentReverse.
77	Variable n : nat.
78	Implicit Types (s : {perm 'I_n.+1}).
79	
80	Definition rev_perm_ord : {perm 'I_n.+1} := perm (@rev_ord_inj n.+1).
81	
82	Lemma rev_perm_ordE (j : 'I_n.+1) : rev_perm_ord j = rev_ord j.
83	Proof. by rewrite permE. Qed.
84	
85	Definition rev_perm s : {perm 'I_n.+1} := rev_perm_ord * s.
86	
87	Lemma rev_permE s (j : 'I_n.+1) : rev_perm s j = s (rev_ord j).
88	Proof. by rewrite permM rev_perm_ordE. Qed.
89	
90	Lemma is_descent_rev s (i : 'I_n) :
91	  is_descent (rev_perm s) i = ~~ is_descent s (rev_ord i).
92	Proof.
93	rewrite /is_descent !rev_permE.
94	have E1 : rev_ord (widen_ord (leqnSn n) i) = lift ord0 (rev_ord i).
95	  by apply/val_inj; rewrite /= /bump /= add1n subSn // ltn_ord.
96	have E2 : rev_ord (lift ord0 i) = widen_ord (leqnSn n) (rev_ord i).
97	  by apply/val_inj; rewrite /= /bump /= add1n.
98	rewrite E1 E2.
99	set a := widen_ord _ _; set b := lift ord0 _.
100	have ab_ne : a != b by rewrite -val_eqE /= /bump /= add1n neq_ltn ltnSn.
101	have sab : s a != s b by apply: contra ab_ne => /eqP /perm_inj ->.
102	by rewrite ltn_neqAle leqNgt sab /=.
103	Qed.
104	
105	Lemma des_rev_perm s : des (rev_perm s) = n - des s.
106	Proof.
107	rewrite /des /descent_set.
108	have revK : involutive (@rev_ord n) by move=> x; exact: rev_ordK.
109	rewrite -(card_imset _ (can_inj revK)).
110	have -> : [set rev_ord x | x in [set i | is_descent (rev_perm s) i]]
111	       = ~: [set i | is_descent s i].
112	  apply/setP => j; rewrite !inE; apply/imsetP/idP.
113	  + by case=> x; rewrite inE is_descent_rev => Hx ->.
114	  + move=> Hj; exists (rev_ord j); first by rewrite inE is_descent_rev rev_ordK.
115	    by rewrite rev_ordK.
116	by rewrite cardsCs setCK card_ord.
117	Qed.
118	
119	Lemma des_rev_perm_ord : des rev_perm_ord = n.
120	Proof. by rewrite -[rev_perm_ord]mulg1 -/(rev_perm 1) des_rev_perm des_id subn0. Qed.
121	
122	End DescentReverse.

26	Definition apply_psis (ops : seq nat) (w : seq nat) : seq nat :=

34	Inductive cde := C_letter | D_letter | E_letter.
35	
36	Definition classify_vertex_cde (i : nat) (w : seq nat) : cde :=
37	  if ~~ is_internal i w then E_letter
38	  else if has_left_child i w then D_letter
39	  else C_letter.

42	Definition phi'_w (w : seq nat) : seq cde :=

49	(* The list of internal vertex positions, sorted. *)
50	Definition internal_vertices (w : seq nat) : seq nat :=
51	  [seq i <- iota 0 (size w) | is_internal i w].

53	(* Expand a cd-word into the multiset of seq bool words.
54	   c = a + b expands to {[false], [true]}.
55	   d = ab + ba expands to {[false;true], [true;false]}. *)
56	Fixpoint expand_cde (letters : seq cde) : seq (seq bool) :=
57	  match letters with

59	  | C_letter :: rest =>

64	      [seq false :: true :: t | t <- tails] ++ [seq true :: false :: t | t <- tails]

69	Definition powerset_internal (w : seq nat) : seq (seq nat) :=
70	  let ivs := internal_vertices w in
71	  foldl (fun acc i => acc ++ [seq s ++ [:: i] | s <- acc]) [:: [::]] ivs.

73	(* Lexicographic order on seq bool (for sorting multisets). *)
74	Fixpoint leq_seqb (s1 s2 : seq bool) : bool :=
75	  match s1, s2 with
76	  | [::], _ => true
77	  | _ :: _, [::] => false
78	  | b1 :: s1', b2 :: s2' =>
79	    if b1 == b2 then leq_seqb s1' s2'
